purpose: Test whether a pre-release economist consensus can be recovered from contemporaneous public sources without look-ahead.
do_not: backtest FX or create trade rules

fields.indicator: CPI_HEADLINE_MOM | CPI_HEADLINE_YOY | CPI_CORE_MOM | CPI_CORE_YOY | NFP_PAYROLL_CHANGE | UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE | AHE_MOM | AHE_YOY
fields.publication_time_utc: normalized clock or null if date-only
fields.lead_time_minutes: release minus publication; null if no clock
fields.retrieved_at: when the page was opened for this pilot
fields.validation_status: VERIFIED_PRE_RELEASE | PRE_RELEASE_DATE_ONLY | SINGLE_FORECAST_ONLY | POST_RELEASE_ONLY | CONFLICTING_SOURCES | NOT_FOUND
fields.qa_official_first_print: Stage 1 first print for this indicator; not replaced
